component.name: MiniBrowser
component.summary: A small but full-featured web browser built with PyQt6 + QtWebEngine

description.p: MiniBrowser is a lightweight desktop web browser that supports tabbed browsing, bookmarks, history, download management, proxy configuration, and developer tools. It uses the QtWebEngine (Chromium) rendering engine for modern web compatibility.

ul.li: Multi-tab browsing with drag-and-drop tab reordering
Bookmarks and SQLite-backed history with search
Configurable search engine (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Baidu)
